what.title: Join the MicoPay Network
what.lead: Give cash to people who need it and earn a commission for doing so.
what.body: Agents are what make cash available in MicoPay. When someone near you wants to convert crypto to bills, you hand them the cash and receive crypto plus your commission.
what.noBusiness: You don't need to have a business. It can be a store, a stall, or an individual. We don't require business paperwork.
what.decisions: You decide your commission, your amounts, and your schedule. No one assigns you trades: you accept the ones you want.
what.noMode: You'll keep using MicoPay as usual. Being an agent doesn't put you in a separate mode: you can request a cash-out as a customer whenever you want.

expect.title: What it involves
expect.lead: It's worth knowing beforehand, not afterward.
expect.identity: You'll need to verify your identity. It's not optional: handling cash in exchange for digital assets requires it by law from the first peso.
expect.area: We'll publish your area, not your address. The exact meeting point is only visible to the other person once a trade is underway, and they stop seeing it when it ends.
expect.cash: You need to have cash available when you accept a trade. If you don't, pause: it takes one tap.
expect.meetup: You'll meet strangers in person. Choose a public, busy place.

checklist.title: What's left
checklist.lead: You can leave and come back: your progress is saved.
checklist.refreshHint: Once you complete all three items, you can activate. If you just finished one, return to this screen to refresh it.
checklist.suspended: Your account is suspended. Contact us so we can review it.
checklist.blocked: Complete the remaining items to become active.

done.title: You're an agent!
done.lead: There's one last step, and you decide when.
done.body: You're already part of the MicoPay Network, but you don't appear on the map yet. We thought it was more honest not to publish you immediately: you choose when to start.
done.available: When you have cash on hand, make yourself available from your profile and you'll start receiving requests.
done.pause: Set yourself to pause when you can't serve. You'll still be an agent; you'll just stop appearing.
